historic_survey.survey: Neighborhood Commercial Buildings Historic Context Statement (2022)
historic_survey.note: Listed on the National Register of Historic Places as the Doolan Residence and Storefronts, one of the city's National Register-listed neighborhood commercial buildings.

historic_survey.survey: Progressive Era & Early Revival Styles Historic Context Statement (2023)
historic_survey.note: The Richard P. Doolan/Norman T. Larson Residence and Storefronts built in 1903 — an extremely rare Colonial Revival mixed-use building, with Palladian windows carrying projecting shelf mouldings, oval windows and a hipped roof.

historical_record.description: The Mnasidika clothing boutique traded in this storefront from 1965 to 1968; reportedly the first hip clothing store in the neighbourhood and instrumental in the Haight-Ashbury's development as a hippie enclave.

building.completed_conflict: The assessor's roll gives 1910; the city's statement on Progressive Era and early revival styles gives 1903.
